thread:
Ritika: Quick follow-up from the morning postmortem — p95 and p99 jumped during two short windows. I think we need a small temporary SLO adjustment and clear owners for remediation items.

Sam: Saw the same. Root cause looks like concurrent cache churn + model tier fallback. Doc: https://redwood.internal/pm/789.

Jared: Can we get a dashboard that breaks p95 by model_variant and shows fallback_rate + queue_depth? Current single p95 hides the inter-variant skips.

Nora: I'll own the dashboard tile. ETA Fri 2026-04-03. Will include: model_variant p50/p95/p99, fallback_rate (per-min), async_queue_depth.

Ritika: Proposal: temporary p95 SLO from 250ms -> 320ms for a 10-day burn window to prevent noise and allow fixes. We also add an alert if error_budget burn > 0.4% in 24h. Any concerns?

Sam: I support the temporary SLO increase but want it gated: auto-revert in 10 days unless action items are done. Also add an annotation in SLO history for transparency.

Jared: I'll take routing policy change to prefer smaller model_variant when instance_queue > 100. Target 2026-03-30 21:00 UTC for canary rollout.

ops-bot: Change window requested: 2026-03-30 21:00-21:30 UTC. Please confirm approvals.

Nora: Dashboard PR draft up: ```yaml
panels:
  - name: model_latency_by_variant
    metrics: [p50, p95, p99]
    group_by: model_variant
  - name: fallback_rate
    metrics: [rate_1m]
  - name: async_queue_depth
    metrics: [gauge]
```

slo-bot: Created SLO ticket #901: 'temp p95 relax -> 320ms, 10-day auto-revert' assigned to Ritika.

Ritika: Error budget update: we burned ~0.9% this incident window (2.5 hours) — that's large. I propose we allocate emergency buffer from the monthly pool and add a burn-rate alert at 0.4%/24h.

Sam: I'll add the alert and link runbook page https://redwood.internal/runbooks/latency. ETA Mon 2026-03-29.

Jared: For canary, I'll do 5% traffic to routing tweak, monitor p95 & fallback_rate for 30 mins, then ramp. @Nora please ensure dashboard refresh is 30s for the canary.

Nora: setting refresh to 30s and adding an annotation hook for canary start/stop. PR ready by EOD.

Ritika: Recurring pattern noted: similar spikes ~monthly aligned with large batch ingestion jobs starting in the US evening. Product to review batch schedules and consider shifting to offpeak or throttling.

Sam: Opening task for Product to evaluate batch windows and introduce jitter/throttles.

ProductOps (via thread): Acknowledged, will investigate batch timing and provide recommended schedule by 2026-04-08.

Jared: Summarizing owners & deadlines: Nora (dashboard + refresh) by 2026-03-27, Jared (routing/canary) by 2026-03-30, Sam (alerts + runbook linkage) by 2026-03-29, ProductOps (batch schedule) by 2026-04-08.

Ritika: I'll update the postmortem with these follow-ups and the SLO change request, and cc Support/Legal for any SLA customer notifications. We'll reconvene next Wednesday in ops sync to close items.

Sam: :white_check_mark:

slo-bot: SLO ticket #901 updated with auto-revert and audit trail.
